scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w website
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web,website -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web" "npm run dev -w website"
scripts.reset-db: rm -f server/data/trippy.db* && echo 'Database reset. It will be re-seeded on next server start.'
